data.message: Retrieving the official financial statement PDF from the CSE document repository
Document secured and staged for processing
Running multi-dimensional financial health diagnostics with LLM (this may take a minute)...
Health diagnostics finalised for BFL.N0000 — overall score: 79/100 · Good

standardHealthChecks.name: Liquidity Health
standardHealthChecks.description: The Group maintains a current ratio of 1.39 (Current Assets of Rs. 4.67B vs Current Liabilities of Rs. 3.36B). However, the quick ratio is lower at 0.58 due to significant holdings in inventories and consumable/bearer biological assets.

standardHealthChecks.name: Profitability Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Strong turnaround in profitability for the quarter. Gross margin increased to 20.6% from 12.7% in the previous year, while Net Profit reached Rs. 241.98M compared to a net loss of Rs. 21.65M in the corresponding prior period.

standardHealthChecks.name: Debt Management
standardHealthChecks.description: Total interest-bearing debt and lease liabilities stand at Rs. 2.83B against Total Equity of Rs. 7.05B, yielding a comfortable Debt-to-Equity ratio of 40.2%. Interest coverage ratio is healthy at approximately 6.9x.

standardHealthChecks.name: Cash Flow Health
standardHealthChecks.description: Generated positive Operating Cash Flow of Rs. 289.61M for the quarter. Free Cash Flow remains positive after accounting for capital expenditure on PPE and biological asset investments.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Biological Asset & Inventory Exposure
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Biological assets (bearer and consumable) and inventories aggregate to Rs. 2.73B, accounting for ~58.6% of total current assets. Proper management and biosecurity controls are vital to protect these assets from mortality risks and market devaluation.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: In poultry farming and agribusiness, live biological assets are central to revenue generation but carry heightened biosecurity, disease, and spoilage risks.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Cost of Sales & Input Price Efficiency
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Cost of sales dropped from 87.3% of revenue in Q1 2025 to 79.4% in Q1 2026, driving a 95% increase in Gross Profit to Rs. 858.20M, reflecting strong procurement efficiency and feed cost control.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Poultry processors are highly sensitive to feed prices (maize, soy) and raw material inflation; cost efficiency directly dictates operating profitability.

dynamicHealthChecks.name: Fixed Asset Productivity
dynamicHealthChecks.description: Non-current assets (primarily PPE) of Rs. 7.44B generated Rs. 4.17B in revenue for the quarter (~2.24x annualized asset turnover), demonstrating strong utilization of farm facilities and processing assets.
dynamicHealthChecks.relevanceReason: Capital-intensive agricultural processing requires high throughput across hatcheries, processing plants, and farms to maximize returns.

recommendations: Refinance or restructure short-term financing liabilities (Rs. 1.96B current payable) into longer maturities to improve the quick ratio and lower refinancing liquidity risks.
Maintain strict biosecurity and disease management protocols to mitigate valuation and operational risks associated with biological assets.
Continue hedging or securing raw material supply agreements to cushion margins against feed cost volatility.
result.analysisNotes: Bairaha Farms PLC demonstrated a substantial financial recovery during Q1 2026, posting net earnings of Rs. 241.98M compared to a net loss in the prior year period. The share subdivision (1 to 5) completed in December 2025 has enhanced liquidity in trading while basic EPS expanded to Rs. 2.78.
